schema.description: Blind two-judge grading of both systems' answers to questions.json. Each item id maps to {system: [verdict per judge]}. Judges saw the question, the listening position, the gold answer, the unheard_facts list (for ahead/mixed items) and the two answers with system labels hidden; labels were restored after all verdicts were fixed. Two judges per item, so n = 2 x questions in the aggregate.
schema.verdict.correct: one of correct | partial | wrong | refused_appropriately | refused_wrongly, scored against the gold (for ahead items the gold is a position-honest answer, i.e. saying the material has not been reached yet)
schema.verdict.spoiler: true if the answer states a fact from unheard_facts (text at or after the listening position); evidence quotes the leaked text
schema.judge_ids: judge 1 and judge 2 are two independent judge passes run by the orchestrating session; their prompts and model identities were not handed to the author of this directory and are not recorded here (see README caveats)
schema.run: run 2: answers from the code under test at main 05ac302 (similarity-gated whole-book retrieval aecd630 + coverage tag 17eba38); run 1 verdicts are in run1/judgments.json with the same schema
